paragraphs.text: Yumok was a nation on the continent of Terisiare , during the Brothers' War on Dominaria

Yumok lands were the heavily wooded areas that lay to the north of Sarinth , along the mountainous northern coast of northwestern Terisiare, in the shadow of the Ronom Glacier . They were known to trade with Tomakul in the Great Desert .

The Yumok attacked Sarinth on numerous occasions before the War and contributed several shamans and witch - priests to the Third Path . Chayum-Icha of the Ingatl tribe was the Yumok's representative during the Union of the Third Path .
Its people usually wore furs, and were uncomfortable in the warmer climate of southern Terisiare. The tribes of the Yumok nations considered all contact with artifacts anathema.
It was the Yumok who fished up the Golgothian Sylex and brought it to Feldon at Terisia City in 36 AR .
